Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that educational credits used to increase teachers' salaries are earned at verified accredited educational institutions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to verification of educational credits used forcertificated employee salary increases; adding a new section to chapter28A.415 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.415RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The office of the superintendent of public instruction shallverify that credits earned by certificated staff, that are used toincrease earnings on the salary schedule consistent with RCW28A.415.023, are obtained from an educational institution accredited byan accrediting association recognized by rule of the higher educationcoordinating board. (2) No salary increase may be approved before there has beenverification of accreditation under subsection (1) of this section. (3)(a) Certificated staff who submit credits received from anunaccredited educational institution for the purposes of receiving asalary increase shall be fined three hundred dollars. The fine shallbe paid to the office of the superintendent of public instruction andused for costs of administering this section. p. 1 SB 5634 (b) In addition to the fine in (a) of this subsection, certificatedstaff who receive salary increases based upon credits earned fromeducational institutions that have been verified to be unaccreditedmust reimburse the district for any compensation received based onthese credits.
